parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the IPAM instance is deployed. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh: IPAM托管地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the IPAM
parameters.name: ipam_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the IPAM scope. Valid values:

- **public**: the public scope.

- **private**: the private scope
parameters.help_zh:
IPAM作用范围的作用域类型。取值：

- **public**：表示为公网类型。
- **private**：表示为私网类型
parameters.name: ipam_scope_type

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs of the IPAM scopes
parameters.help_zh: IPAM作用范围的实例ID列表信息
parameters.name: ipam_scope_ids

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IPAM scope.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
IPAM作用范围的名称。

长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: ipam_scope_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the IPAM scope belongs
parameters.help_zh: IPAM作用范围所属的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

element_fields.help_en:
The tag key. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length. It must start with a letter. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The tag key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh:
标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持64个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

- You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query.

- For a subsequent query, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned from the last query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
- 第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
- 如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时返回的最多条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results
